name: sources.sync_status
description: Sync status and lag for all external sources
querySql: SELECT es.name, es.source_type, es.sync_strategy, es.is_active, sc.table_name, sc.checkpoint_type, sc.checkpoint_value, sc.rows_processed, sc.last_synced_at, now() - sc.last_synced_at AS lag FROM tessera.external_sources es LEFT JOIN tessera.sync_checkpoints sc ON sc.source_id = es.id ORDER BY es.name, sc.table_name
